notes.title: Version 1.0 is out now
notes.content:
More than a year of early access is over

[b]The game is officially out![/b]

We improved many things that were in the early access
[list]
[*] animations
[*] backgrounds
[*] balance changes
[*] hud
[*] levels length
[*] new menu
[*] and more...
[/list]

on the example of these screenshots you can see the progress:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33707604/1daf00a98dade5416131dd5162da85734968f0d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33707604/63800f0dbc8f774870cc49c78eb1ba271b7e4f7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33707604/65c623a1fde0913aa646dcaf8a1feeebb37c15d8.png[/img]

Now you can complete the game to the end.
[u]if you has played in early access please start new game to avoid the bugs[/u]


[b]Thank you for support![/b]
[b]We hope you will enjoy the final result![/b]

notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE! (finally)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33707604/77d96b914475ad6c4b98fe223a2062e4cb508fd7.jpg[/img]


[b]Hello players![/b]
sorry for the long absence!
It was a harsh spring for us, but we got back to business.

 [b]So what do we have:[/b]
[list]
[*]  3rd level with 2 different "biomes" and new type of traps
[*]  Magnificent boss(with lot of animations)
[*]  New enemies of course
[*]  + a little changes on previous levels.
[/list]


Also we added a level selection if you don't want to play now but want to see all locations
And we added a full recovery button, so press F4 if you have any troubles in your journey 
(it all will be removed with game release)

notes.title: Full second level released!
notes.content:
[b]Hello players![/b]

This is our first update in this year!
We finally made up the second level and we hope you'll enjoy it!

[b]Whats New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Second Boss.
[*] 7 new locations.
[*] New Enemy
[*] Animated Backgrounds
[*] 1 new achievement.
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Also we did over 50 copies! 
[b]So thank you again for suporting our project![/b]

If you find any bugs or you have any suggestions for the game, please let us know.

notes.title: The first Major Update(a half of it at least)
notes.content:
[b]Hello players![/b]
[b]Thank you all for suporting our project![/b]

Sorry for being out of schedule, one of our pc has broken.
Because of it, this major update contain only the half of new level.
But also we added something new for the first level!


[b]So...what do we have here:[/b]
[list]
[*] New animation and pattern for the first boss.
[*] New NPC.
[*] New level with 13 locations.
[*] 3 New enemies.
[*] Replaced some animations (deathcloud was ugly).
[*] Now in some locations on level one you can easily see the secrets.
[*] 1 new achievement.
[*] All bugs that we (and you) has found - fixed 
[/list]

But there is one problem, due to changes in the structure of levels,[u] old saves doesn't work.[/u]
[u]So you'll need to start a new game.[/u]
I hope this never happens again, sorry!

[i]Have a wonderful holidays![/i]
